mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.2% signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as capital flows into risk assets.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 1.2% in 70% of instances but 20-day forward returns remain negative in >60% of cases with statistically insignificant mean return (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 248.0 indicates accelerating inflation, triggering central bank rate hikes that compress equity earnings multiples and produce negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 248.0 but 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of cases with Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1260.0 AND RSAFS < 485000.0 but 20-day returns positive in >60% of cases with negative correlation to target.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 growth above 2.5% annualized signals robust economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings visibility and producing positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 2.5% but 60-day returns negative in >60% of instances with statistically insignificant mean return (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO falling below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and producing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns due to immediate earnings concerns.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.0 but 5-day returns positive in >60% of cases with Rank IC < 0.03 over 1-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE below 4.0% signals tight labor markets, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations that reduce equity risk appetite, producing negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% but 20-day returns positive in >60% of cases with negative correlation to target.

mechanism_narrative: Joint improvement in PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline below 4.2% signals strengthening labor market dynamics, increasing consumer spending and producing positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 147000.0 AND UNRATE < 4.2% but 20-day returns negative in >60% of cases with Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS stability below 1.2% during post-shock recovery periods reduces policy uncertainty, enabling sustained equity market gains and producing positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 1.2% in post-shock periods but 60-day returns negative in >60% of cases with statistically insignificant mean return (p > 0.05).
